scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in the lightweight checker sandbox, so the checker compares the agent-reported values to hidden paper-derived references with tolerance, plus structural sign/ordering checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference MA energies for FFFFFF/, CCCCCC/, CCCCFF/ and eta_MA for CCCCFF/
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'MA energy for pure Fe film (FFFFFF/) is positive, 1.34 meV/unit-area, while for pure Co film (CCCCCC/) it is negative, -0.54 meV/unit-area'. For CCCCFF/, the value is read from Fig. 4(b) DFT MA energy (grey circle, FF group) as ~0.9 meV/unit-area. Eta_MA for CCCCFF/ extracted from Fig. 4(d) as ~0.5 (meV/unit-area)/(V/Å).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper's stated numbers and figures; the oracle solve.sh hard-codes them, so the checker is built around those.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's published results for the same quantities, units, and configurations; no invention needed.

outputs.description: Computed magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) for three atomic-layer configurations: FFFFFF/, CCCCCC/, and CCCCFF/. The checker verifies the reported MAE values against hidden paper-derived reference values with tolerance, and additionally checks that the signs and ordering satisfy structural constraints (FF>0, CC<0, CCFF>0 and >CC).

Computed electric-field-induced MA modification, η^MA, for the CCCCFF/ configuration. The checker verifies the value against a hidden paper-derived reference with tolerance, and checks that η^MA is positive and consistent with a single-Fe-layer dominated mechanism.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker uses paper-derived reference MAE values for the three configurations (tolerance 0.5 meV/unit-area) and a reference η^MA value (tolerance ~0.2 meV·V⁻¹·Å⁻¹). Structural checks: FFFFFF/ MAE > 0, CCCCCC/ MAE < 0, CCCCFF/ MAE > 0 and greater than CCCCCC/, η^MA positive.

steps.description: Check MAE values against paper references (tolerance = 0.5 meV) and enforce sign/ordering constraints.
Check eta_MA against paper reference (tolerance = 0.2) and enforce positivity.
